propositions: _intersect_capabilities collapses prompt_cache_style to "none" when fallback chain candidates disagree (Bedrock+Anthropic mixed classes), disabling caching on the primary Bedrock model that serves 99.6% of calls

Since commit 6d4f394195b2 (2026-08-12), mixed-provider frontier/standard class configuration caused cache-read fraction to drop from 65-82% to 0.0% and doubled median plan-review cost from ~$2.18 to ~$4.82

The collapse premise (cross-provider cache keys would error) is false; cache keys are provider-scoped ModelSettings; each provider reads only its own keys via .get() so foreign keys are silent misses, not errors
The Anthropic fallback fires only 0.43% of calls (51/11,902 logged rows), so collapsing to "none" unnecessarily disables caching on the primary for 99.6% of serving candidates

Fix derives prompt_cache_style from per_candidate[0] (primary/serving candidate) instead of intersecting all candidates, while preserving conservative all(...) intersection for hard-fail fields (temperature, structured_output, thinking)
Stale documented intent must be updated in four sites: _intersect_capabilities docstring, rebar.toml [llm.model_classes] note, docs/llm-framework.md caching stanza, and ADR 0059 §7
